edits.value: I recommend a Counsel clinician review your rash in this message thread, with a same-day target during service hours. Your description fits a contact rash on both forearms after plant exposure. Seek same-day in-person care if you develop fever, spreading redness with warmth or increasing pain, pus, or rash on your face, eyes or genitals; call 911 for throat tightness or breathing difficulty. Do these regardless of whether you have a reply here. If messaging isn't available to you, contact another clinic or urgent care instead of waiting.
